scalar_identity: byte-equal raw Montgomery inputs across independent proof processes
accepted_relations: child = sign*2^exponent*parent+offset modulo the BN254 scalar field; signs ±1, exponents 0..3, offsets -2..2
cost: For each removed class, subtract one group merge, exponent doublings and the direct correction add/double cost. Count each as one operation.
selection: Evaluate sign only, dyadic, offset and combined families. Descending net savings with deterministic tie breaks and disjoint endpoints.
bound: Relax disjointness and parent retention for the selected arithmetic model. Sum the best positive net saving for each possible removed child.
criterion: Prefer implementing this route only if modeled net savings approach 10% of post-grouping digit arrivals for both queries on both inputs.
limitation: Exact field identity and synthetic weighted-sum check. No latency measurement, actual curve addition count or production change.
